Dominoes

Waiting for opponent...

Opponent: 7 tiles · Boneyard: 14

Double-six dominoes. Match either open end of the chain. If you cannot play, draw until you can — pass only when the boneyard is empty. Empty your hand, or finish with the fewest pips.

Hangman Duel

Waiting for opponent...

Opponent: 0 wrong

You are both racing the SAME word. Guess letters — 6 wrong guesses and you are out. Finish first, or finish with fewer mistakes.

Math Duel

? + ?

Simon Duel

Waiting for opponent...

Round 1 · Sequence of 3

Watch the sequence, then repeat it. It grows by one every round. Fail a sequence your opponent completed and the match is theirs.

Word Chain

Waiting for opponent...

Your word must start with the last letter of the previous word. 4+ letters, no repeats, 20 seconds per turn. A bad word or a timeout costs one of your 3 lives.
